name: Togglix Variation Switcher for WooCommerce
author: Karthick

sections.description:
Togglix Variation Switcher for WooCommerce improves the buying experience by allowing customers to change variation attributes (such as size or color) from the Cart and Checkout pages.

Instead of removing an item and searching the product page again, the customer clicks Edit, picks a new variation, and updates the cart item instantly.

Key Features

  • Edit variable product attributes in Cart and Checkout
  • AJAX-based update flow
  • Compatible with WooCommerce variable products
  • Translation-ready with included POT file

How to Use

  1. Add a variable product to the cart.
  2. Go to Cart or Checkout.
  3. Click the Edit link shown for a variation line item.
  4. Select the new attribute values in the popup.
  5. Click Update to replace the existing cart variation.
  6. The page reloads to reflect the updated variation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Add variable products to the cart and open Cart or Checkout to use the Edit action.
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce must be active for this plugin to work.

Does this support simple products?

No. This plugin is designed for variable products.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. The plugin includes a POT file in the languages directory.
